description: This file defines the EventRepository class in Python, implementing CRUD operations for Event entities using SQLAlchemy ORM. It manages database interactions such as creating, retrieving, listing (with optional search), updating, and deleting Event records.

classes.name: EventRepository
classes.description: Repository for CRUD operations on Event entities, managing database interactions via SQLAlchemy sessions.

methods.name: None __init__(self, db: Session)
methods.description: Initializes the EventRepository with a database session.

methods.name: Event create(self, event: Event)
methods.description: Creates a new Event in the database and returns the created Event object.

methods.name: Optional[Event] get(self, event_id: int)
methods.description: Retrieves an Event by its ID, including its attendees.

methods.name: Tuple[List[Event],int] list(self, skip: int = 0, limit: int = 100, search: Optional[str] = None)
methods.description: Lists Events with optional search by title, supports pagination, returns a list of events and total count.

methods.name: Optional[Event] update(self, event_id: int, data: dict)
methods.description: Updates an Event by its ID with provided data, returns the updated Event or None if not found.

methods.name: bool delete(self, event_id: int)
methods.description: Deletes an Event by its ID, returns True if deletion was successful.
